```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot to visualize the distribution of Sleep Duration across different BMI Categories
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.violinplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, hue='Gender', split=True, palette='muted')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration Across BMI Categories by Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper right')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
